title: Config
objective: Users read, validate, change, hand-edit and recover OpenClaw's configuration through the CLI, the Gateway config methods, chat and agent tools and the Control UI settings pages, normally while turns are in flight, with split $include files, env and secret references, backups and legacy keys present, and through hot reloads, restarts, failed or racing writes, read-only hosts and Doctor migrations.

toWrite: support/verify/gateway-call.mjs  (one Gateway method by name over the env's RPC client; methods called here: agents.create, agents.update, config.get, config.openFile, config.schema, config.schema.lookup, cron.list, gateway.suspend.prepare, gateway.suspend.resume, health, status; --env --method <name> --params <json> [--out <file>] [--after-ms <ms>] --timeout <ms>)
support/verify/chat-send.mjs  (chat.send then chat.history for the reply; used for /config show, set and unset and for marker messages; --env --session-key <key> --message <text> --timeout <ms>)
support/verify/chat-history-read.mjs  (chat.history for one session; --env --session-key <key> --timeout <ms>)

support/verify/agent-tool-turn.mjs  (a turn whose scripted mock reply calls one named tool, then chat.history with tool results; tools used here: browser, exec, gateway, openclaw, read, sessions_history, theme; --env --session-key <key> --tool <name> --args <json> --timeout <ms>)
support/verify/session-turn-hold.mjs  (sessions.send with a reply the mock provider holds open; --env --session-key <key> --hold-ms <ms> [--timeout <ms>] --background --handle <file> | --wait <file>)

support/verify/control-ui.mjs  (one named Control UI flow in a headless browser against the env's Gateway, writing screenshots; flows used here: appearance-browser-locale, appearance-forced-colors, appearance-no-corner-shape, appearance-offline-theme, appearance-plugin-theme, appearance-read-only-connection, appearance-reduced-motion, appearance-reduced-transparency, appearance-shared-token, appearance-theme-switch, appearance-two-tabs, chat-tool-events, connection-password-mode, links-external-off, links-external-on, settings-agent-switch-during-save, settings-appearance-observe, settings-appearance-theme, settings-array-row, settings-autosave-paused, settings-chat-sidebar-prefs, settings-connection-modes, settings-connection-offline, settings-connection-retrying, settings-draft-refresh, settings-footer-observe, settings-form-edit, settings-form-save-include, settings-gateway-switch, settings-gateway-switch-pending, settings-invalid-setting, settings-language, settings-legacy-browser-state, settings-links, settings-links-clear-site-data, settings-native-embed, settings-navigate, settings-notifications, settings-offline-prefs, settings-raw-edit, settings-raw-open-file, settings-save-recovery, settings-save-retry, settings-search, settings-search-ime, settings-security, settings-tab-icon, settings-theme-catalog-error, settings-theme-import, settings-theme-import-clear, settings-unapplied-banner, settings-unknown-outcome, tab-icon-lobster-locked; --env --flow <name> --artifact-dir <dir> [--session-key <key>] [--locale <locale>] [--gateway-env <env>] [--profile <id>] [--storage-state <file>] [--emulate <media feature>] --timeout <ms> [--background --handle <file> | --wait <file>])

support/verify/config-write.mjs  (config.patch, config.apply or config.set with a baseHash from a config.get result, written as given; --env --method <config.patch|config.apply|config.set> (--raw <json5> | --raw-from <file> | --merge <json5> onto the current config) [--drop <path>] [--base-from <config.get result file>, else a fresh config.get] [--replace-paths <json>] [--repeat <n>] [--revert-after-ms <ms>] [--out <file>] --timeout <ms> [--background --handle <file> | --wait <file>])
support/verify/config-applied-wait.mjs  (config.get polled until appliedConfigHash equals the saved revision or the timeout elapses, recording every poll; --env --timeout <ms>)

support/verify/config-file-edit.mjs  (an editor-style change to openclaw.json or one included file through the filesystem, no product method; --env --file <openclaw.json|include path> [--mode <in-place|rename-replace|prefix>] (--merge <json5> | --set-from <patch file> | --replace-from <file> | --text <raw> | --touch | --chmod <octal>) [--out <file> recording the original for --restore] | --restore <file>; --timeout <ms>)

support/verify/stage-state-fixture.mjs  (stops the env's Gateway, saves the config and state files a fixture replaces, copies the fixture into place; --restore puts the saved files back; --start-gateway starts the Gateway afterwards; --env (--fixture <path> --save-original <file> | --restore <file>) [--start-gateway] --timeout <ms>)

support/verify/config-dir-fault.mjs  (makes the env's config file unreadable or its backup slots or directory read-only, and clears that again; --env (--fault <config-unreadable|backup-readonly|dir-readonly> | --clear) --timeout <ms>)

support/verify/cli-pty.mjs  (runs one openclaw command for the env under a pseudo-terminal, answering prompts from a file; --env --command <args> [--answers <file>] [--cli-profile <name>] [--env-var <KEY=VALUE>] --timeout <ms>)
support/verify/rotate-gateway-secret.mjs  (config.patch of gateway.auth.token with a generated value, then updates the env's stored client credential; --env --timeout <ms>)

product: ocm @{env} -- gateway diagnostics export --output <file> --json  (writes a redacted diagnostics archive; --output --json)
product: ocm @{env} -- approvals get --json  (reads exec approvals together with the Gateway config; --gateway --json)

product: ocm @{env} -- agents bind  (binds an agent to a channel account, writing config; --agent --bind)
product: ocm @{env} -- agents delete <id>  (removes an agent, writing config; no flags)

product: ocm @{env} -- plugins enable <id>  (enables a plugin, writing config; no flags)
product: ocm @{env} -- plugins disable <id>  (disables a plugin, writing config; no flags)

product: ocm @{env} -- nodes list --json  (lists nodes after a nodes policy change; --json)

phases.intent: A user has asked the main session something the model is still answering, so every later phase runs while that turn is in flight and holds channel and plugin work; the started turn and its handle are observed.

While a turn is in flight a user reads settings through the Gateway method, the CLI, the /config chat command and both agent tools, including an unset path, a params-bag path and managed meta; each redacted value or explanation is observed.
A user and an agent look up the config schema and path-scoped nodes for channels and reload settings with plugin and channel schemas loaded; the schema documents and lookup nodes are observed.
A user whose config lives outside the state directory asks where it is and opens it from the CLI, the Gateway method and the raw editor's Open action; the reported path and open results are observed.

A user and the system agent validate a config with env files, ${VAR} references (set, missing, escaped, lowercase), SecretRefs on active and disabled surfaces and a manual exec provider; the validation reports and warnings are observed.

While a turn is in flight a user sets and removes single settings from the CLI (value, dry run, conditional and SecretRef builder forms), the /config chat command and the system agent's staged proposals on a hand-edited JSON5 config; the writes, hints, proposals and the saved file are observed.
commands: ocm @{env} -- config set logging.audit.executionIdentity true --strict-json --expect-current-json false

phases.intent: A user changes several settings in one write through config.patch and openclaw config patch (dry run, file, replacePaths for an intentional array removal, an id-keyed provider model array); the changedPaths, refusals and saved file are observed.
commands: node {kovaRoot}/support/verify/config-write.mjs --env {env} --method config.patch --raw '{ models: { providers: { {persona:config-id-keyed-arrays:providerId}: { models: [{ id: "{persona:config-id-keyed-arrays:modelId}", contextWindow: 64000 }] } } } }' --timeout 60000 --out {run}/patch-3.json

phases.intent: A user replaces the whole config with config.apply (applied) and config.set (persisted only) built from the current snapshot; both acknowledgements and the saved file are observed.
A user hand-edits openclaw.json and the included plugins file of a split config with an editor-style write; the watcher's reload, the applied snapshot and the files are observed.

A user opens Settings from a chat link, searches (including while an input method is composing), follows sidebar links, every route and alias, moved-section redirects and a ?section= deep link, section tabs and the Advanced accordion, then exits, with old browser settings, attention chips pending, under token and then password auth and in native embed mode; screens and URLs are observed.

A user edits every field kind in the settings form (text, number with steps, select with null, segmented, toggle, JSON, secret reveal, object, array and map rows) on an include-split config, opens advanced groups, switches Form and Raw, dismisses the invalid warning and peeks env values; screens and saved values are observed.

A user autosaves, applies a restart-required change, retries a failed save, discards a draft, reads a rejection reason and saves after a paused autosave while a turn is in flight; the save indicator states and saved revisions are observed.
A user reveals the redacted raw config, edits it, views pending changes, discards and then saves; screens and the saved file are observed.

A signed-in profile picks themes (including a plugin theme with one color mode and no mascot), color mode, accents, fonts and text size beneath a gateway-wide accent, the agent lists and sets themes, and the page is checked under forced colors, reduced transparency and reduced motion; screens and saved preferences are observed.
A user imports a tweakcn theme into the browser-local slot, replaces it and clears it, and the agent imports one through the theme tool; the slot, active theme and screens are observed.
A user whose browser locale is right-to-left loads the Control UI, then overrides and resets the language; lazy-loaded translations, English fallbacks and the saved choice are observed on screen.

While a turn is in flight a user switches the browser tab icon between Default, an agent without an avatar and a Lobsterdex lobster not unlocked in this browser; the favicon, activity dots and saved choice are observed.

A user changes every chat and sidebar preference in two tabs on one Gateway, collapses the sidebar in one tab, and repeats as a read-only operator and as a connection without a profile; per-tab and synced values, gateway-backed preferences and screens are observed.
A user with the Open links in Control UI browser preference set turns Open links outside OpenClaw on and off and clicks a web link and a preview card; navigation targets and screens are observed.

A user sets account-default and per-device notification categories, lock-screen detail, quiet hours and agent filters, subscribes this browser to push and sends a test; saved preferences and screens are observed.
An administrator toggles Browser enabled, changes Available tools and opens Pair device on the Security page; the config writes, the pairing dialog and screens are observed.

A user with a copied redact pattern runs a turn whose reply, tool output and provider error carry placeholder secrets of several shapes (long, short, form body, Digest header, registered secret); console and file logs, transcript, sessions_history, Control UI tool events, diagnostics export and WebSocket logs are observed.

While a turn is in flight other features read the live config: the Gateway probe, the TUI, exec-approvals command and the claws Gateway check, model auth activation and the agent's gateway tool; their results are observed.

A user adds and binds an agent, changes the default model and a skill allowance through the CLI and Gateway agent methods, each a config write from another area; the written config and acknowledgements are observed.
A user disables and re-enables the external plugin, reloads it and previews a claw, each writing config from the plugins area; plugin inventory, config writes and logs are observed.
Plugins and tools save their own settings while a turn is in flight: /dreaming toggles memory-core and the browser and file-transfer tools persist their policy; config writes and logs are observed.
Connected channels run inbound turns that make them write back their own settings (target and binding write-backs); channel status, config writes and logs are observed.
A user applies an exec-policy preset, turns telemetry off, dry-runs a secrets plan and runs security audit --fix, each a config write from another CLI area; outputs and the saved file are observed.
A user previews and applies an import of Claude Code settings present on the Gateway host; the migration plan, report and config writes are observed.
A user reruns baseline setup and setup status on an existing installation; the baseline writes and the config are observed.

A user runs openclaw config and openclaw configure under a terminal, from a CLI profile whose paths differ from the service and with OPENCLAW_HOME relocated, on an explicit agent fleet without a System Agent, runs configure without a terminal, and asks the system agent to configure the Gateway; prompts, refusals, printed commands and writes are observed.
With the Gateway already started on the persona config, a user runs ordinary and terminal CLI commands that pass the config guard; startup records, status and guard output are observed.

An operator whose hand-edited config keeps two keys from an older version runs Doctor and Doctor --fix with a full backup ring present; findings, repairs, warning-only plugin results and the .bak ring are observed.
A new user's Gateway runs with no config file and a first config.patch writes one without a baseHash, observing the safe defaults, the created file and the in-memory main agent.
A user whose openclaw.json is a symlink saves a value, observing the refused or retargeted write and what the link and its target hold afterwards.
A user keeps the config outside the state directory through OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH and reads, writes and validates it, observing the resolved path and the file written.
A user edits openclaw.json directly while a turn is in flight and the file watcher applies it, observing the source revision logged as a file edit and the applied hash.
A tool writes a config that would clobber the existing one over config.apply, observing the blocked write, the rejected payload saved beside the config and the warning.
A tool writes a config without the effective gateway.mode over config.apply, observing the blocked write and its gateway-mode-missing-vs-last-good reason.
A tool writes a config less than half the size of the current one, observing the blocked write and its size-drop-vs-last-good reason.
A tool writes a config without meta, observing the write anomaly recorded.
An agent reads config through the gateway tool with an explicit gatewayUrl override, observing the client path taken and the same redacted payload as the in-process read.
A tool sends more config writes than the per-minute limit from one device, observing which writes are refused and the retry hints.
A tool saves two restart-required changes within thirty seconds, observing coalesced restart requests and the cooldown between restart cycles.
Two writers change the config from the same read: the CLI with a conditional expectation, then config.patch with the stale baseHash, observing the conflict answers and that nothing was overwritten.
A tool saves a hot change with config.patch and the same change with config.set while a turn is in flight, observing that config.patch answers after application and config.set after persistence.
A tool changes only a channel's allowlist and DM policy, covered by the plugin's dynamic-read contract, while a turn is in flight, observing publication without a channel restart or drain.
A tool saves hot and restart-required settings in one write, then a later hot write, observing one deferred transaction and the restart requirement kept.
A tool's write is still waiting for application when the watcher observes the same file content, observing the RPC staying pending through replay and its final answer.
A second tool write with different content supersedes a first one still awaiting application, observing UNAVAILABLE for the first and the applied revision of the second.
A tool saves a plugin entry whose runtime cannot apply, then retries unchanged, observing the persistedConfig receipt, the no-op retry and the recovery guidance.
A tool saves a newer change while a committed reload is still finishing its channel and model work, observing the order of application and any UNAVAILABLE answer.
A tool changes a plugin's entry while the setup turn keeps that plugin busy, observing the failed drain, the last-good runtime and the replacement retried once the work finishes.
A plugin setting change stays unapplied behind busy plugin work, observing config.get's appliedConfigHash against the saved revision and the Control UI's unapplied-config notice.
A user's editor saves openclaw.json through a temp file and rename, observing one settled read and the applied revision.
A tool saves a restart-required change and the watcher sees the file echo, observing that the write keeps its receipt and restart intent.
A user edits the file by hand while a tool's write is finalizing, observing both changes reconciled, the root file still present and the backup ring after the conflict.
A tool points an agent at a workspace with retired setup state, observing the rejected live change, the Doctor hint and the unchanged runtime.
A user turns reload off, saves a hot change and installs a plugin, observing the change waiting for a manual restart and the plugin action applied.
A tool saves a restart-required Gateway setting in hybrid mode while a turn is in flight, observing the automatic restart and the turn's outcome.
A tool changes cron and heartbeat settings, observing only those subsystems restarting.
A tool changes session, message and tool settings, observing the snapshot update with no reload action and the next read using it.
A tool changes a key whose reload rule comes from a plugin that is not loaded, observing the Gateway restart it falls back to.
A tool changes agents.defaults.mediaMaxMb, observing channel runtimes restarting together.
A tool changes model settings, observing authored settings kept apart from catalog defaults after the hot reload.
A tool changes model selection and providers while the Codex plugin runs, observing the hot apply without a Codex drain.
A tool changes an agent's sandbox tool allow and deny lists, observing the hot apply without plugin service restarts.
A tool changes a channel transport setting, observing session rows and model catalogs kept.
A tool changes the agent roster and session policy, observing the invalidated facts and their rebuild.
A tool changes provider authentication inputs, observing catalog requests waiting for the replacement publication.
A tool changes session.store and back, observing no migration, queued notifications ending store-replaced and suspended child-result delivery.
A tool changes one channel setting under the plugin's restart prefix and one under its no-op prefix, observing which restarts the channel.
A tool changes one plugin's entry, observing that instance replaced and re-registered while others keep their registration.
A tool changes approval, install policy, diagnostics flags and ACP settings, observing them applied to the next operations.
A tool changes update and telemetry settings, observing the next check using them and no forced update.
A tool changes gateway.publicOrigin, observing new URLs and browser reconnects.
A tool changes Gateway HTTP endpoint settings, observing the next request served under them.
A tool changes meeting capture settings, observing capture writers reconciled.
A tool changes the authentication rate limit, observing recorded failures and lockouts kept.
A tool changes the discovery mode, observing advertisements replaced without dropped connections.
A tool changes browser control policy, observing the Browser control service replaced and pending operations cancelled.
A tool changes channels.defaults and command policy, observing loaded channel runtimes refreshed and stopped accounts kept stopped.
A tool changes inbound debounce and ackReactionScope while a turn is in flight, observing the next admission using them without reconnects.
A tool toggles diagnostics and the OTel exporter settings, observing live dispatch and only the exporter restarted.
A tool turns audit collection off and on, observing accepted writes drained and earlier events not reconstructed.
A tool changes operation settings and approval expiry while a turn is in flight, observing the in-flight run untouched and new grants using the new expiry.
A tool changes internal-hook settings including one that fails to load, observing previous handlers kept and no gateway:startup replay.
A tool changes the Control UI environment label and embed settings, observing them applied without a restart.
A tool narrows allowedOrigins, observing pending handshakes rechecked and disallowed browser connections closed.
A tool disables then re-enables the Control UI, observing pages stop serving and 503 answers until assets are ready.
A tool toggles custom plugin UI, observing plugin views refreshed and removed.
A tool changes ACP and worktree acceleration settings, observing them applied to the next admissions.
A tool changes the terminal shell and disables then re-enables terminals, observing new terminals using it and existing sessions closed on disable.
A tool changes gateway.reload and gateway.remote, observing no restart.
A user installs, disables and enables a plugin with reload off, observing each lifecycle action applied without a restart.
A tool changes roles and identity scopes for the second operator, observing connections fenced and accepted work kept or revoked.
A tool sets logging.file to a stable path, observing where later log lines go.
A tool lowers maxFileBytes and the Gateway logs past it, observing the rotation and the numbered archives.
A user sends a message while a plugin hot reload drains the old runtime, observing the request paused and continued with the replacement.
A user's Gateway uses password auth: the Control UI connects with the password and the CLI reads config, observing the password kept in memory only and the accepted secret field.
A user edits an included plugins file, observing the reload plan built from the source layout (hot or restart) and the applied revision.
A user references an unset environment variable in a config value, observing the unresolved value, the warning and the consumer that cannot use it.
A user selects a non-default secret provider alias without its provider entry, observing validation and resolution answers.

A user saves a Settings form change in a config whose credentials live only in an included file, observing the included secrets kept and the write placement.
A user edits an intermediate include while a tool write is persisting, observing the write refused or its leaf rolled back.

A user writes OPENCLAW_CONFIG_READONLY into config env.vars on a writable install, observing that it does not make config read-only.
A deployment system edits the read-only config and the Gateway reloads it, observing the reload applied and read-only mode unchanged.
A user edits agents with legacy agents.list paths and whole-list inputs, observing the keyed roster persisted.
A user expands a single-agent root config with a legacy roster, observing the default marker retired with explicit owners.

A user removes a broken inactive provider with config unset, observing the unblocked repair.
A user dry-runs and then writes a SecretRef that cannot resolve, observing the resolvability error and the unchanged config.
A user sets an unknown model and a provider-pinned one as the default from the CLI, observing the rejected write and the accepted pin.

A user's saved Lobsterdex tab icon is opened in a browser where that lobster is not unlocked, observing Default shown and the choice kept.
A user connected with only the shared token changes theme, accent and tab icon, observing the gateway-config sync and the browser-local tab icon.
A user is on Settings while the Gateway restarts, observing Connecting and Reconnecting states and Apply and reconnect after an edit.

A user opens the Control UI for the first time with an Arabic browser locale, observing the localized page and lazy translation loads.

A user browses themes while a theme plugin is enabled, updated and disabled, observing the catalog after each plugin hot reload and a selected theme becoming unavailable.
